title: roadmap-focals-lens-prep
content:
Purpose: quick personal prep for a short cross-functional sync (20–30m) between Product, Engineering, and Applied ML. Goal is to surface the top 3 decision points that need agreement this quarter and to capture immediate action owners so we can avoid a long follow-up thread.

Meeting context and constraints:
- Timebox: 25 minutes. Keep discussion at decision level, not implementation.
- Attendees: Lina (Prod), Marcus (Eng TL), Arjun (Applied ML), me (Felix). Invite optional: Priya (ops) if rollout constraints pop up.
- Inputs: latest traffic/latency numbers (INF-3421), model quality regression flags from eval harness, and the new Dedicated capacity pricing memo.

Top hypotheses to validate (voice them briefly at start):
1) Hypothesis A — Shorter context models + MV LRU caching gives 20–30% token-cost reduction without user-visible regressions on chat flows. Need ML validation and perf projection.
2) Hypothesis B — Rolling model A/B on Dedicated is safe for 99th percentile latency if we limit batch window to 20ms; otherwise can violate SLO. Requires SRE/infra confirmation.
3) Hypothesis C — Product tradeoffs: prioritizing deterministic lower-cost model paths for paid users will reduce churn but may increase support burden. Need comms + pricing check.

Agenda (5 / 10 / 10):
- 0–5m: Quick framing + which hypothesis each stakeholder bakes in as top priority (one-sentence each).
- 5–15m: Discuss Hypothesis A (ML perf + eval risk). What experiment signal would convince Product to proceed?
- 15–25m: Operational constraints (Hypothesis B) and rollout guardrails. Decide if a short pilot or can jump to canary.
- Quick capture of owners and deadlines (final 2 mins).

Pre-reads / what I will bring:
- Short perf table (p50/p95/p99) for the candidate quantized variants (one-pager).
- Eval highlight: failure modes by prompt category (top 5) and simple prompt set to run locally.
- Cost delta estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted mix (back-of-envelope).

Open questions to ask (in order):
- For Lina: which user cohorts are high priority for cost/lateral quality tradeoffs? (Paid trial vs enterprise.)
- For Marcus: what infra telemetry would you need to greenlight a canary? (specific metrics & thresholds for rollback).
- For Arjun: what minimum eval pass rate would you accept before shipping a model variant to production? How do we define "pass" for safety-sensitive prompts?

Quick risk matrix (talk through if time):
- User quality risk: medium — mitigations: prompt-level filters + eval gating.
- Latency/regression risk: high for p99 on heavy sequences — mitigation: batch tuning + fallback to larger model.
- Cost risk: low-to-medium — starts positive but unknown long tail.

Action items to capture during meeting (format: task — owner — ETA):
- Decide priority cohort for pilot — Lina — EOD +1
- Run 3k prompt eval sweep against quantized variant and deliver confusion table — Arjun — +3 days
- Provide precise p99 budget envelope and rollback signal list — Marcus — +2 days
- Draft a short canary playbook (steps + abort criteria) — Felix (me) — +4 days
- If pilot approved, schedule infra slot on Dedicated pool (capacity booking) — Ops — +5 days (force invite Priya)

Notes to self / reminders while running the meeting:
- Avoid deep technical detours; park them to a follow-up technical breakout. Use a shared doc to capture those parked items.
- If Lina signals product-level OK, confirm pricing table line items immediately so Sales doesn't get surprised.
- If Arjun flags safety red (low pass rate), push for a targeted prompt set subset we can iterate on quickly.

Post-meeting follow-up template (I will paste into Slack + update doc):
- Short summary of decisions (1–2 bullets).
- Owners with exact deliverables and dates.
- Link to artifact folder (perf tables + eval outputs).
- Proposed date for technical breakout (30–60m) if needed.

Unresolved / parking lot (for follow-up):
- Cost allocation method for hybrid Hosted/Dedicated flows — needs finance input (cc: Kyle).
- Long-term metric: define a user-visible quality KPI we all agree on (suggestion: task success rate on core prompts).

Quick back-of-envelope numbers to mention if asked:
- Estimated token cost reduction: 18–28% (median expectation).
- Expected additional p99 delta risk: +10–30ms if batching is not tuned.
- Canary window recommendation: 48–72 hours for per-route traffic volumes ~500–2k rps.

End note: keep this lean, surface only what we need to decide now. If we get alignment we can run a tightly scoped pilot and report back next sync.

Raw scratch lines (if I need to scribble during call):
- "Pilot cohort = enterprise search -> sample 2 customers"
- "Abort if p99 > target by 15% for >10m consecutively"
- "Eval pass = no safety regression on top-20 prompts + >=95% quality retention on product prompts"
- "Owner check: Felix to make playbook; Marcus to confirm telemetry; Arjun to run eval"
summary: Personal prep notes for a 25-minute cross-functional sync between Product, Eng, and Applied ML. Contains framing, hypotheses, agenda, pre-read list, open questions, risk matrix, and a compact action-item template to use during the meeting.
